text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno was furious. She resolved to 
stand up against that utterly outrageous 
opponent.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...There is neither foolishness nor 
extremism in the way I run.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I possess neither the glamour nor the 
popularity needed to stand out.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"I've got the legs to run right beside 
someone trying to break away all on their 
own...!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's a plain, boring run, I'll 
cling to it—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —I will fulfill my duty of justice!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno increases her speed, pursuing 
furiously.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Reflected in her eyes as she runs is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —It's the little brat I saw that day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on the day of the Aoba Sho.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Boss. I will seize the ticket to the 
Derby right here.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
On the stage everyone yearns for, the 
right Umamusume must be the one to shine.
choice_data_list:
Go out there and win with your own 
running.
Go and win with your running.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Without fail, victory in the race! 
Fenomeno, moving out!!"
